messages:
laura: FYI - got a customer report that our SCIM sync created duplicate user entries for a few orgs after the SAML NameID change yesterday. seeing provisioning 500s and KMS decrypt errors in the same window.

laura: snippet from provisioning logs: 
```
POST /scim/v2/Users 500
{"error":"duplicate_resource","detail":"existing id mismatch: extId=okta|00uabc123 vs local_id=usr_456"}
```

laura: also seeing KMS failures in app logs: `aws kms decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException` for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-rotated

anika: thanks - quick questions: did we change the NameID format (Email vs transient) or only the attribute release?

laura: we flipped NameID to `emailAddress` for a subset of customers to fix compatibility with some IdPs. mapping for externalId was left as `okta.user.id` for others.

anika: that explains duplicates — if NameID mapping differs we can end up creating a new SCIM user instead of matching on externalId. For SCIM best practice we should be matching on `externalId` or `emails.value`.

mike: on the KMS side: looks like we rotated the key yesterday and the SCIM service role lost `kms:Decrypt` permission to the new key alias. CloudTrail shows `Decrypt` denied for principal arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/scim-service/* at 2026-03-09T21:10:03Z.

mike: quick fix options: 
- re-add the service role to the new key policy (preferred)
- or revert alias to point back to old key (temp)

anika: for duplicates we should: 
1) pause automatic provisioning for affected orgs (prevent more dupes)
2) run a merge script to map extId->existing user and delete/merge dupes
3) update our NameID/attribute-release docs and add a gated rollout

raj: I have a dry-run script to handle merges: `python infra/scripts/fix_scim_dup_users.py --org 6789 --dry-run` — it will match by emails, externalId, and log proposed role reassignments. ran it on staging and it looked good.

laura: posting the exact Okta guide snippet we used, in case you need to reverse: 
```
SAML App > Sign On > Attributes
Name ID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
Name ID value: user.email
```

anika: also: update SCIM mapping to ensure `externalId = user.id` and include an `idpId` claim when available. Add a pre-check in the sync to detect potential duplicates and fail gracefully with a warning to admins.

mike: I'm going to patch the KMS key policy now to add the scim-service role principal with `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey`. Will comment when done.

idp-bot: Automated alert: SAML certificate rotation detected for tenant org-6789 at 2026-03-09T21:09:12Z.

laura: thanks - once KMS is fixed I'll resume provisioning for the affected orgs. can someone capture audit events for compliance? need immutable trail for the remediation.

anika: console -> Audit -> Provisioning events. Export CSV for the window 2026-03-09T20:50 -> 2026-03-09T22:00. Also link CloudTrail KMS events for the same timestamps.

mike: KMS policy updated and CloudTrail shows successful Decrypt at 2026-03-09T21:15:42Z from scim-service.

raj: re-ran the dry-run with current data, now ran real: `python infra/scripts/fix_scim_dup_users.py --org 6789` — it merged 3 duplicate pairs and reassigned roles. logs uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1801234567/merge-log.csv

laura: opened an incident postmortem and customer comms draft (added to #incidents). brief summary: root cause = NameID format change + missing externalId matching + KMS key rotation revoked decrypt perms. Remediation steps listed.

anika: follow-ups: add pre-sync duplicate detection, require externalId mapping in onboarding templates, and add a KMS policy checklist for key rotation runbook.

laura: ok thanks everyone. I'll notify affected customers that remediation is complete and follow up with a short postmortem later. :white_check_mark:
